title: Morning at Sunshine Farm: Meet the Goats and Chickens
reason: The video showcases aspects of a vegan homestead, including farm management, cattle care, and self-sustenance practices.

tasks.task: Introduce the farm and its residents to viewers.

subtasks.text: Explain that the video is an introduction to Sunshine Farm, which has a vegan homestead and permaculture gardens.
Show the farm's companion animals and permaculture gardens.

tasks.task: Highlight the farm's chickens and roosters.

subtasks.text: Describe the three chicken coops and the different types of chickens.
Explain why they have to deal with roosters carefully on a vegan homestead.
Detail the challenges they faced with the roosters and how they resolved those issues.

tasks.task: Show the process of harvesting lunch and preparing a vegan salad.

subtasks.text: Demonstrate the picking and preparation of vegetables for the salad.
Show the process of making the vegan chicken nuggets.

tasks.task: Feature the activity of picking blackberries and show the availability of peaches.

subtasks.text: Highlight the blackberry picking process and the satisfaction of picking them.
Point out the almost ripe peaches on the tree.
